thread:
acme-customer: Hey team — redeemed promo code `WELCOME-ACME-2026` through our account (org_ABC123) about 08:12 UTC. UI and confirmation email said success but balance still shows $0. Request id `req_0a9f`. Can you check?

elaine - Support: Sorry about that — can you confirm if this was via SSO/onboarding flow or manual web redeem? Also if you have the confirmation email ID that helps.

acme-customer: It was via the onboarding SSO flow. Confirmation email subject: "Your Redwood promo applied" Id in email header: `evt_2026_42`.

billing-bot: webhook delivery: POST /webhooks/promo -> 200 OK 
headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"} 
response-id: evt_2026_42 
payload snippet:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_2026_42",
  "org": {"client_org": "org_ABC123"},
  "code": "WELCOME-ACME-2026",
  "amount_cents": 10000,
  "delivered_at": "2026-03-10T08:12:14Z"
}
```

sam-dev: I can see the webhook arrival in infra logs and the ingestion job processed it. However when the grant handler tried to write to `grants` table the `billing_account_id` came back NULL. Quick query: 
```sql
SELECT id, external_event_id, billing_account_id, amount_cents, status
FROM grants
WHERE external_event_id = 'evt_2026_42';
-- returns: id= NULL (no grant row), ingestion attempted but mapping failed
```

andre-billing: Looks like the partner payload uses `client_org` instead of our standard `org_id` key for SSO redemptions — ingestion mapping didn't pick it up, so downstream mapping to billing account failed and no ledger entry was created. Two options: 1) create grant row manually and apply ledger credit, 2) re-run ingestion with mapping fix. I'll do manual apply if you approve.

elaine - Support: @acme-customer can we proceed with manual credit so you get access immediately? We'll follow up with an engineer fix.

acme-customer: Yes please proceed, we need the credits for demos today.

andre-billing: Running manual fix now. Commands I'll run: 
```sql
-- insert grant and link to billing account
INSERT INTO grants (external_event_id, org_id, billing_account_id, amount_cents, status)
VALUES ('evt_2026_42', 'org_ABC123', 'bill_789', 10000, 'applied');
-- create ledger transaction (internal RPC)
CALL ledger.apply_credit('bill_789', 10000, 'promo:WELCOME-ACME-2026', 'evt_2026_42');
```
Applying...

ops-deploy-bot: background job INF-3245 created: "ingestion: accept client_org key for partner sso webhooks" (PR suggested: 6789).

andre-billing: Done — ledger tx id `ledger_tx_555`. Credits applied to billing_account `bill_789`. Should appear in org balance momentarily (couple minutes). I also added an idempotency guard for `evt_2026_42` to avoid double-crediting.

sam-dev: Root cause summary for the ticket: partner uses `client_org` in SSO flow; ingestion schema expected `org_id`. Fix is to accept either key and normalize to `org_id` before mapping. PR 6789 opened, adding unit tests + integration test against sample partner payload.

elaine - Support: @acme-customer can you check your org balance in ~2 minutes and confirm? Sorry again for the friction. :handshake:

acme-customer: I can see the $100 in the billing dashboard now — thanks @elaine, @andre-billing. Really appreciate the quick turnaround.

elaine - Support: Great — closing the thread for now. We'll update INF-3245 when the ingestion mapping fix deploys and follow up if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
